description: For a site that answers 402 Payment Required and offers the "janus" scheme: once you've paid its Janus Pay checkout (janus_create_checkout with the details in that offer's extra.create) and it shows completed, this returns the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header to send with your request to get the content. Each payment opens one request.
name: janus_x402_proof
title: Proof of payment for an x402 paywall
